title: Alberta Personal Income Tax Act
verified_how: fetched Alberta King's Printer Laws Online catalogue entry (ISBN 9780779859795): title 'Alberta Personal Income Tax Act', Chapter/Regulation 'R.S.A. 2000, c. A-30', Status 'Office Consolidation', Current to 12/11/2025; the Laws Online index header states 'Acts current to 2026-08-31'
notes: Alberta levies its own personal income tax under this Act, but collection and source withholding are carried out federally by the Canada Revenue Agency under a collection agreement, so the withholding machinery itself is in the federal Income Tax Act, R.S.C. 1985, c. 1 (5th Supp.).
